# Graphic Design Skill for Muse

A professional graphic-design reference built for non-designers: the 7 design principles (balance, contrast, emphasis, movement, pattern, rhythm, unity), color theory (RGB/CMYK/HSL/Hex, harmonies, psychology, WCAG contrast ratios), typography (type classification, size hierarchy, pairing rules, two-to-three-font maximum), layout and composition (12-column grids, 8pt spacing system, rule of thirds, visual-hierarchy techniques), file formats (raster vs vector, web vs print export rules), the tool landscape (Figma, Adobe, plus free alternatives like Inkscape and GIMP), print specifics (bleeds, 300 DPI, CMYK, US and ISO paper sizes), and a do/don't best-practices list with a full design-review checklist. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: a static knowledge guide — it teaches design and reviews your work, it doesn't generate art or run any tooling; the fundamentals are timeless, but cross-check specific tool interfaces and WCAG versions against current sources. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
